jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Career Move
jokes.joke: When the aliens invaded, I panicked, but my nanny barely looked up. She said, “I negotiate all day with a three-year-old who screams, bites, and refuses pants. At least these creatures arrived with a clear list of demands.” I realized she wasn’t scared—she was interviewing for a less hostile household.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Nanny Cam
jokes.joke: I hired a nanny, and within a week I felt like I was the one being evaluated. She'd watch me make my kid a grilled cheese and go, “Interesting that you're using butter AND mayo.” Lady, I'm not asking for your review, I'm asking you to keep him alive until 6pm. She rates my parenting like a Yelp reviewer who's never even eaten the food, just glared at the menu.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Apocalypse Group Text
jokes.joke: I realized I wouldn't survive an alien invasion, mostly because I absolutely hate having to rely on others. I’m not joining your ragtag band of apocalypse survivors. The minute some guy named Rick says, “We have to stick together,” I'm walking directly into the tractor beam. I would literally rather be vaporized than participate in a group text to figure out who's bringing the ammo.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Babysitter Critique
jokes.joke: I hired a nanny so I could finally get some work done. Big mistake. She's so judgmental. Yesterday I walked in wearing sweatpants and she just looked me up and down and said, “Casual Friday or giving up?” Now I put on a collared shirt just to take out the trash.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Patio Panic
jokes.joke: I was sitting on my patio the other night when I heard this huge crash in the sky. For a second I thought it was an alien invasion, so I grabbed the only weapon I had: a citronella candle. I stood there like, “Back off, extraterrestrials, I’m lightly lemon‑scented and ready to fight,” which is exactly when my neighbor yelled, “It was a firework, genius.”
